note: THE TRUNK. Pinned 2026-09-15 from the deployed elder. This file judges HISTORY -- blocks a node is fetching to catch up -- and nothing else. It is NEVER written by the nightly retrain, which only ever writes fallback_model.json (the branch). Consensus needs a rule that is the same on every node and the same tomorrow; a model that retrains nightly is neither, and A116 is what that costs: a sentence alleging nothing drifted 0.18 across a threshold and made the chain unjoinable past block 12 for days. The branch keeps learning and keeps full force over NEW transactions. To trim the branch back to the trunk: copy this file over fallback_model.json and retrain from there. See A125.
